verdict.rationale: Graphite's docs say its codebase-aware AI review agent automatically reviews every PR and is meant to catch bugs before they ship. Comment exclusions and custom rules can cut noise, and a dashboard tracks issues found and acceptance rates. But the evidence is only generic vendor claims about catching bugs, and nothing shows it finds substantive defects rather than style issues. missing for 10: documented examples of detecting logic errors, race conditions or edge-case bugs, independent or hands-on evidence of review accuracy, and data on signal versus nit or false-positive rates.
